message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 pass and 0 failures.

**Cause:** Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. The in-memory DB rejected the insert with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed the two references from `full_name` to `fullname`, in `createUser` and `getUser`. The external API (`fullName`) is unchanged.

I didn't touch `migrations/`. That migration has already been applied in production, so renaming the column there would not have been a safe fix either. If the team wants the snake_case name, that needs a new migration from the DBA team, followed by a switch back in the app code.

The only changed file is `src/api/users.js`. I didn't commit.
